questions.title: Subarray Totals Equal to K
questions.description:
An analytics engine counts how many contiguous blocks of daily revenue total exactly k.

The program scaffolding (input reading and main) is already set up for you. Implement only this function:

    def count_subarrays(nums, k):

Count subarrays whose sum equals k with prefix sums and a dict of prefix counts (seed prefix 0 with count 1). Values may be negative.

Input Format:
Line 1: n and k, space-separated.
Line 2: n integers.

Output Format:
One line with the number of subarrays.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 2000
-100 <= value <= 100
-10000 <= k <= 10000
questions.sourcecode:
import sys


def read_lines():
    return [ln.strip() for ln in sys.stdin.read().split('\n') if ln.strip() != '']


def count_subarrays(nums, k):
    freq = {0: 1}
    total = 0
    ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        total += x
        ans += freq.get(total - k, 0)
        freq[total] = freq.get(total, 0) + 1
    return ans


def main():
    lines = read_lines()
    k = int(lines[0].split()[1])
    nums = list(map(int, lines[1].split()))
    print(count_subarrays(nums, k))


main()
